name: Junior Docent Volunteers
what_you_do: Volunteer at an aviation museum. Jobs on the form include exhibits, the front desk, the gift shop, collections, events, museum upkeep and aircraft restoration. No experience needed.
who_can_apply: Young volunteers who go to school. The application asks about your school schedule and clubs. A parent must sign if you are under 18. No minimum age is stated.
duration: You pick 1 to 6 days a week or 1 to 7 days a month; shifts are Tue to Sun, 9 AM to 4 PM
how_to_apply: Fill out the Junior Docent Application PDF (link on the volunteer page), with a short bio. Call 951-902-5949 or email volunteerinfo@marchfield.org.
notes: Museum address: 22550 Van Buren Blvd, Riverside. Ask the volunteer office about the youngest age they accept.
